children: Sentient has scheduled an unlock of about 2.33 billion SENT for investors and the team in January 2027. The tokens in the scheduled release equal 32.19% of the circulating supply.

The unlock increases the amount of SENT available for sale. It removes the restriction that kept recipients from selling these tokens. Once the restriction lifts, those holders can decide how much of their unlocked SENT to sell.

title: Sentient: 2.33 Billion SENT Unlocks for Investors and the Team - Jan 2027
